name: August Robotics Lionel
summary: Autonomous floor-marking robot that paints layout points and marks from a DWG or DXF plan onto large hall floors. Built first for exhibition halls, it is now offered for commercial construction, data-centre, warehouse and industrial fit-out layout.

germany.statusNote: August Robotics has an office in Düsseldorf and a German-language Lionel page for industrial fit-out marking with three options on request: marking as a service, leasing (training and support included) or purchase of a Lionel fleet. No public price.

sellers.name: August Robotics
sellers.note: Office at Oberbilker Allee 270A, 40227 Düsseldorf (About page). Price options on the page: 'Bedienung' (send CAD plans for a quote; August team marks on site), 'Leasing' and 'Kauf'; contact form on the page.

notes: Marks points (rack corners, hanger points, MEP and equipment positions, labels) rather than continuous wall lines; several paint colours.
Works best in large indoor areas with limited clutter and dirt and in dry conditions; navigates around people and obstacles (maker).
Fleet operation: the system splits the job between several robots.
Since March 2025 new robots get the 'Lionel PX' dot-matrix paint mechanism; existing robots can be converted by a parts swap.
Drive type is not described in the text read; wheels assumed from a floor-driving robot of this kind.
